context: Evaluates correct usage of the useScene store's scene lifecycle actions. The candidate must use loadScene to initialize the default Site→Building→Level hierarchy, clearScene to reset it, unloadScene to empty it, and setScene to replace it with external data.

checklist.name: loadScene call
checklist.description: Calls useScene.getState().loadScene() to initialize the scene, resulting in at least one SiteNode, one BuildingNode, and one LevelNode in the nodes map.

checklist.name: loadScene idempotency
checklist.description: Does not call loadScene when the scene already has rootNodeIds populated — relies on the built-in no-op guard rather than adding external checks.

checklist.name: clearScene call
checklist.description: Uses clearScene() to reset the store, which internally calls unloadScene then loadScene, restoring the default hierarchy.

checklist.name: unloadScene call
checklist.description: Uses unloadScene() to fully empty the store, resulting in an empty nodes object and empty rootNodeIds array.

checklist.name: setScene call
checklist.description: Uses setScene(nodes, rootNodeIds) to bulk-load an externally provided scene, replacing all current state.
